archive_classification: Clean-room, specification-based independent replication. These are regenerated outputs and are not the lost original J0-J7 raw matrices.
conventional_selector_boundary: J0/J2/J3 use fixed-cardinality residual-energy-proportional sampling without replacement because the lost original conventional energy-weighted selector was not uniquely recoverable.
deterministic_seed_streams: topology=seed; sink shadowing=seed+1000; transmission errors=seed+2000; reciprocal pair shadowing=seed+3000; sensing/events=seed+4000; AD-CWOA=seed+5000; conventional selector=seed+5100; J7 shuffle=seed+6000003
primary_interpretation: Independent replication/robustness check only. It does not replace the frozen manuscript data and is not used to silently revise reported original results.
